name: sin-user-process
source: User-approved SiN mask conventions; override per declared process or device specification.

ports.source: Current user-approved tapeout defaults; fiber pitch applies only when an array interface is requested.

pads.device_kind_basis: Optical cavity topology, not the number of independent devices or die repetitions.

single-ring-heater-stagger150.source: 2026-10-nine-chip-array/chip_07/README.md and layout-05/README.md, electrodes.py; reuse only for the matching accepted component
single-ring-heater-stagger150.optical_topology: Y branch feeds one membrane cavity and one reference cavity on separately exiting arms; electrode pair belongs to the single membrane cavity.
single-ring-heater-stagger150.source_electrical_topology: Independent two-pad circuit per heated cavity; no shared return in this source.
single-ring-heater-stagger150.group_anchor_policy: Explicit per-device anchor; preserve local pad pair while allowing groups at different heights.

single-membrane-phase-stagger200.source: 2026-10-nine-chip-array/chip_09/big-membrane-die-preview/README.md and build.py; reuse only for the matching accepted component
single-membrane-phase-stagger200.optical_topology: One ring with two coupling points per independent optical device; four devices per die do not form a cavity array.
single-membrane-phase-stagger200.source_electrical_topology: Independent two-pad phase-heater circuit per device; no shared return in this source.
single-membrane-phase-stagger200.group_anchor_policy: Explicit per-device anchor; retain each pair offset without imposing common group height.

array-shared-bus-ring-heater-stagger200.source: 2026-10-nine-chip-array/chip_02/final, chip_04/final-v3, chip_06/final-v4 and chip_08/final-v2: README.md and electrodes.py; accepted shared-optical-bus array components
array-shared-bus-ring-heater-stagger200.optical_topology: Sixteen cavities addressed along one routed optical bus per die; reference straight waveguide is separate.
array-shared-bus-ring-heater-stagger200.source_electrical_topology: Source designs explicitly join return pads with a common metal rail; a new design must declare its actual electrical network separately.
array-shared-bus-ring-heater-stagger200.source_group_organization: Source signal/return rows at die-local y=3900/4100 um, pad pitch 250 um; these source anchors are not global placement defaults.
array-shared-bus-ring-heater-stagger200.group_anchor_policy: Explicit per-device anchors and declared probe-row organization; local pair equality does not impose anchor heights or create a common-return rail.

pads.source: Resolve fixed pad size and intragroup probe spacing from an accepted component. Optical topology selects single/array; pair geometry, group anchors and electrical topology remain separate declarations. No common group height or common return is inferred.

tessellation.sin_distribution: uniform arc-length stations on each smooth curve; circular curves use equal angles
tessellation.source: Design-guide figure: perpendicular distance from middle point C to adjacent A-B line should be around 0.1 nm; user clarification requires <0.1 nm for SiN. Other-layer ~1 um step is user-approved.
